rationale: No-spec round (no story/spec artifact supplied). Blind lens: no findings. Edge-case lens: two major findings. (1) The w-full spacer causes a 3-4 row layout on medium-width viewports where row-1 chips already wrap, defeating the intent of the fix. Fix: explicit wrapper divs for each group. (2) Empty div between form controls has no aria-hidden, breaking screen-reader flow. Fix: add aria-hidden=true. 0 deferred, 0 dismissed.

findings.problem: The <div className='w-full' /> spacer forces a line break unconditionally, but on medium-width viewports (~900-1100px) where earlier filter chips already wrap, the spacer lands mid-wrap and pushes the DatePickers to a third or fourth row instead of the intended second row.
findings.impact: Layout regression on medium screens: filter bar renders 3-4 rows, wastes vertical space, and pushes the data table out of view without scrolling. Defeats the stated fix intent on non-wide viewports.
findings.recommendation: Replace the spacer with two explicit wrapper divs: wrap (Domain, Event type, Entity type, Actor ID, Entity ID) in one <div className='flex flex-wrap gap-3 w-full'> and (From, To, Sort, Clear) in a second, removing the spacer div entirely.

findings.problem: The empty <div className='w-full' /> is not hidden from the accessibility tree. Screen readers may announce it as 'blank' and interrupt reading flow between the Entity ID input and the From DatePicker.
findings.impact: Accessibility regression: screen-reader announcement stream is broken between two logically related filter controls.
findings.recommendation: Add aria-hidden='true' to the spacer: <div className='w-full' aria-hidden='true' />. This is a one-character fix if the spacer approach is kept.
